title: Stack Left (AlignAndSize)

scenarios.title: Stack Left applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Stack Left (BtnDockLeft) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Dock stacking cursor is pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: Dock Left places every non-anchor shape directly left of the reference shape in selection order with zero gap: the first shape's left sits at (reference left - its width) and the cursor follows each placed edge leftward; the other coordinate, size and formatting are untouched.
